The review loop is complete: **round 14 came back with "generated no new comments"**, all threads resolved, and the full `internal/cli` test suite is green (96s).

## Loop summary — 14 rounds, 21 findings addressed, 1 rebutted

Copilot reviewed, I fixed/replied/resolved, and re-requested until clean. Findings by round:

| Round | Findings | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `vizGraphViewCap` "0 = render all" sentinel not honored | Fixed (`cd3e8aac`) |
| 2 | Unbounded `?limit` on facts/sessions/docs; `relLimit` up to 3.6M | Fixed — clamp centralized in `vizQueryLimit`, `relLimit` ceilinged (`bed4fd80`) |
| 3 | Chunked-query cost (temp-table suggestion) | **Rebutted with evidence** — indexes give a multi-index OR plan, ~27ms/chunk measured; per-chunk LIMIT required for merge correctness |
| 4 | `/api/graph` ignored `?limit=0`; CSP navigation | Fixed — routed through `vizQueryLimit`; added `form-action`/`object-src 'none'` (`d2562f73`); external links defended as intentional |
| 5 | `sourceLink` missing URL escaping; ranking pool 3× the ceiling | Fixed (`0cca15af`) |
| 6 | `ENTIRE_WEB_BASE_URL` scheme injection; unbounded search `?limit` | Fixed (`ea4a1db7`) |
| 7 | Silent `fs.Sub` failure → blank UI | Fixed — `mux()` returns the error, command fails loudly (`d6e2f7a0`) |
| 8 | `/api/summary` leaked the absolute local path | Fixed — path-free `repoDisplayName()` (`cd868772`) |
| 9 | Empty-ID records collide in facts/docs | Fixed in all four feature handlers, preempting sessions/history (`75314745`) |
| 10 | Totals computed before the empty-ID filter | Fixed (`dc596e3a`) |
| 11 | O(chunks×limit) merge memory; missing HTTP timeouts | Fixed — early trim keeps merge O(limit); full timeout set (`7d5a7b33`) |
| 12 | Windows backslashes in links; per-call map alloc | Fixed (`efbd655b`) |
| 13 | Misleading doc comment on `relationsForSymbols` | Fixed (`10afb42e`) |
| 14 | **No new comments** | ✅ Loop terminated |

Every fix round ran `go build`, `go vet`, `gofmt`, and the viz tests before pushing; each finding got a reply on its thread explaining the fix (or the empirical rebuttal in round 3), and every thread is resolved. PR #55's branch is now 13 commits ahead of where the loop started, with the full test suite passing.
